resolved_conflicts.explanation: The blog gives 1,439 feet and Mapcarta gives 1,411 feet (430 metres). The story reports both and does not choose between them.
FFLA lists Gartin (Mann) Knob, the blog body calls the tower Manns Knob, and Mapcarta uses Gartin Knob. The story uses Gartin Knob and notes the variants.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Standing status, county and coordinates come from the FFLA list only. Agency comes from the Forest Lookouts list. The 1930s build date, the house and the 1,439 ft elevation come from one personal blog. Mapcarta gives 1,411 ft. Not on the NHLR West Virginia list as crawled. Design, staffing, access and fires are unknown. No photos added (blog photos are personal with no license). A county, Forest Service or Division of Forestry record would firm up the build date.
